It hasn’t stopped wagging since the video started. This isn’t a dog pretending everything is fine. This is a dog living inside real pain, real limitations, a body that fights it every single day — and still choosing joy like it’s the easiest decision in the world. We complain about bad days with bodies that work exactly the way they’re supposed to. This dog wakes up inside a body that doesn’t, and still finds a reason to wag.
